requirement: Only the SKU's approved/default supplier may be used in MVP.
The Agent does not compare suppliers or switch suppliers automatically.
If a reorder SKU has no default/qualified supplier record, mark the SKU commercial decision as BLOCKED / Needs Attention.
If unit price is missing/invalid, do not fabricate it; create a blocking exception for PO preparation.
important_qualification: This is a chosen control, not a universal ERP rule.

requirement: If supplier-item MOQ is defined, final order quantity must respect it.
If a supplier-item fixed lot multiple is defined, order quantity must respect it.
Lead time can be held as supplier-item data and used for explainability/feasibility checks.
Valid reorder lines mapped to the same supplier are grouped into one PO draft for the run.
important_qualification: No claim this is mandatory practice.

requirement: Agent may prepare a draft, but final save/export as approved order requires human approval.
If supplier, quantity, or unit price changes after approval, status resets to Needs Review.
basis: Project control grounded by workflow concept
important_qualification: Specific critical fields are a project design choice.

requirement: Line Amount = Quantity × Unit Price; PO Total = sum of line amounts.
important_qualification: Tax excluded unless team later defines tax treatment.

requirement: Each PO line keeps the source/replenishment decision reference used to prepare it.
